title: Snow globe desk ornament

title: Hot cocoa break

title: Penguin assistant
summary: A small penguin prop that appears at the desk now and then to hand Kori more papers, with a waddle animation and complaint quips.

title: Paperwork avalanche

title: Ice skating idle
summary: A new idle animation where Kori glides along the taskbar on skates instead of walking, with a little spin at the end and skating quips.

title: Winter weather rotation
summary: Seasonal props by month: a scarf in winter, sunglasses in summer, a tiny pumpkin in October, with matching quips.

title: Snowball fight
summary: An interval behavior where Kori packs a snowball and throws it off screen, then looks around innocently, with denial quips.

title: Officer quip pack vol. 2
